scope: Hosted Actions SSH transport and protected host gate orchestration
proofs: Real temporary Git commit archive with checksum and embedded exact commit
Long Unicode PAX path roundtrip; traversal, links, duplicate paths and metadata rejected before extraction
Strict SSH known-host verification, no agent/port forwarding, credentials on stdin
Host repeats actual GitHub metadata command before accepting candidate provenance
Failure injection at every host command boundary cleans attempt Docker credentials; cutover never automatically repeated
Invalid or incomplete final receipt rejected without successful public upload
Global manifest resolves all new mandatory test selectors
Signal during Docker auth write waits for command boundary, blocks following gate and then removes recreated config; timeout/output-bound executor waits for local child close
remaining: Run root combined core and complete sharded extended on the final source snapshot
Provision and validate actual protected host configuration/Node/key and pinned OCI artifacts
Run actual hosted SSH deployment with legacy adoption after readiness; mixed-component cutover/rollback remain separate actual gates
limits: Fault adapters are unit fixtures, not evidence of actual Docker or TimeWeb cutover
Hard host kill may leave private short-lived Docker auth; inspect and clean the owned attempt before recovery
Unknown SSH outcome requires existing journal inspection/recovery, never blind apply retry
